name: Micah
summary: A man of mount Ephraim who made a house of idols and hired a Levite as his own priest, in the days when Israel had no king. Men of the tribe of Dan later carried off his gods and his priest.

key_moments.title: Silver Made into Idols
key_moments.description: Micah gave back the silver he had taken from his mother, and she had part of it made into a carved image and a cast image. He set up a house of gods and made one of his sons his priest, in days when every man did as he saw fit.

key_moments.title: A Levite for a Priest
key_moments.description: A young Levite from Bethlehem-judah came by, and Micah hired him as his priest for ten shekels a year, clothes and food. Micah said that now the LORD would do him good.

key_moments.title: The Danites Take His Gods
key_moments.description: Men of Dan took his images and his priest. Micah chased them and cried that they had taken the gods he made, but they were too strong, so he went home, and they went on to Laish.
